rationale: The optimal strategy minimizes total diesel cost by maximizing the sum of battery power output over the horizon (sum(battery_mw)). This is achieved by charging the minimum amount required in period t1 (-2.0 MW) to enable a full discharge in period t2 (+12.0 MW), which has the highest net load. In period t3, with high PV and lower net load, no battery action is required (0.0 MW). This schedule respects all generator, battery power, SOC, and efficiency constraints, resulting in the minimum total diesel cost of $9435.0.
